keywords_en: FOCIL formally proposed as a Hegotá headliner
a hash based quantum resistant upgrade shield
summary_en: soispoke and coauthors formally proposed FOCIL (EIP-7805) as a Hegotá headliner. VitalikButerin laid out a scaling hierarchy: computation scales more easily than data, and data more easily than state. Nethermind research measured per opcode proving time. nerolation submitted first accessed indices for BALs.
